interface.shortDescription: Your AI memory as a local folder you own
interface.longDescription: OpenMyMemo keeps what AI assistants know about you in Markdown files on your own computer. After a one-time setup (ask Codex to "set up OpenMyMemo"), Codex reads your memory at the start of each session and writes what it learns. Additions apply right away and show up in a digest in the OpenMyMemo panel at http://127.0.0.1:8787, where you can undo them; changes to anything you wrote yourself, and private topics, wait for you. Turn approval on to review every change first. The same memory works in Claude, Cursor and VS Code.
defaultPrompt: What do you remember about me?
Remember that I prefer concise answers that lead with the conclusion.
